note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the event and the obligations are generic placeholders, never real contract text. The substituted datum is the supplied state of the event — produced or pending, supplied states of equal weight (● and ◆ of the same area, colour and stroke); its only dependent geometry is the bracket, which marks the supplied tranche as supplied. No rule on conditions is stated: no condition precedent or subsequent, no fulfilment, no automatic effect, no obligation that becomes due, binding or enforceable, and no jurisdiction. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): clauses (the event card and the obligation cards stand for the clauses), schedules, definitions and priorities (no priority or order between obligations is drawn). focusTarget has one value (the event card's state row). No stress field is capped.
